subject: Mathematics
grades: 10-12 (one SAG per subject covers the FET phase)
role: IEB counterpart of the DBE Grade 12 Examination Guidelines AND the DBE SBA programme: the single document that specifies how the IEB assesses this subject - NSC examination structure (papers, marks, durations, cognitive-level spread) and the Grades 10-12 school-based assessment requirements for IEB member schools.
edition_model: SAGs are reissued per examination year; always take the newest edition for the exam year being taught. The edition current when this index was authored targets the 2026 examination year - confirmed via search-indexed copies for Mathematics (2026 edition, updated August 2025); for the other subjects the 2026 label is inferred from the per-exam-year reissue model, not yet confirmed per subject.
status_detail: ieb.co.za refuses automated fetching from this build environment (HTTP 403; the environment's egress policy also blocks general web fetches). URLs were located and recorded via web search on 2026-08-03 but the documents themselves are not yet fetched or verified. Run lessons/curriculum/IEB/scripts/fetch_ieb_sources.py from a network-enabled machine, then ingest per the CAPS method (full-text .md + structured .json next to this index).
terms_note: (c) IEB; not reproducible for commercial gain - see lessons/curriculum/IEB/SOURCES.md before ingesting PDFs or embedding questions.

documents.title: IEB Subject Assessment Guidelines: Mathematics, 2026 examination year
documents.url_note: Per-document download URLs sit behind ieb.co.za's bot-blocking front end and could not be captured from this environment. Capture in a browser session on source_page (record here, then scripts/fetch_ieb_sources.py verify/fetch-sags), or download in the browser and `register` the file.

ingestion.method: Mirror the CAPS exam_guidelines ingestion: full decoded text as .md with page markers, plus a structured .json carrying document metadata and the exam structure (papers, marks, durations, section weights, cognitive-level weightings) exactly as printed in the SAG, followed by a manual pass against the rendered pages. No numbers may be transcribed from third-party re-uploads (Studocu/Scribd) - only from the fetched official PDF. Then fill ../syllabus/scope_deltas.json and re-derive skills exam-weight overlays.

maintained_by: hand-owned: seeded once, then mutated by lessons/curriculum/IEB/scripts/fetch_ieb_sources.py and SAG curation passes - NOT generated by build_from_caps.py (a regenerate must never clobber recorded provenance). Contract validated by scripts/audit_tree.py.
